webster.text: Literally, having that first which ought to be last; inverted in order.

more.text: Perverted; wrong; absurd; contrary to nature or reason; not adapted to the end; as, a republican government in the hands of females, is preposterous.

example.quote: In the establishment, therefore, of civil government, it would be preposterous to rely on the discretion of any men.
example.cite: John Adams, A Defence of the Constitutions of Government of the United States of America, vol. 1 (London, 1787), ch. 4
